SuperMAG Monthly Website Statistics
===================================

The following SuperMAG website monthly statistics are reported:

Hits	      Number of "hits" or page views of the site per month.

Uniq IP	      Number of unique IP addresses observed per month, this represents
     	      a proxy for the number of users of the site.

Users	      Number of users that have registered with the site for this month.
	      The total number of registered users is given in parentheses.

Downloads     Number of ASCII data file downloads per month.

Plots Viewed  Number of data plots viewed per month.
